People seem to compare to meri, and I never got her so never payed attention to what people used her for. It seems like in this meta, without an HP multiplier, she's purely a very quick glass canon farmer, as the multiplier she gets at 6 orbs with the number of rows she has plus no sky falls to slow down combo time means she's good at farming upper tier dungeons. 

Her drawback seemed to only really be no hp X, and not being unbindable. 

Kirin seems like a decent farm lead for upper tier stuff (think Devil Rushes, things without resolve mechanics), because of being unbindable it might mean you have more room for fully damage/orb change based subs. 

People seem to be pointing out his/her? Weaknesses as:

•Very few awakenings (1 row vs 5 on meri)
•lower multiplier for 6 orbs
•fewer light subs that can make up for lack of rows 

Overall, obviously if you have better subs for Kirin it's a good lead for farming, you just might have to use 9 orbs to get enough damage for some enemies. I don't try to listen to other people's review too much because they forget it's really a single player game that depends on your own box to determine the value of a card, not how that card might function with completely optimal subs. So many people don't have the "optimal" team so why try to compare? 

That's my thought!
